correctness.rationale: For n>=3, the RK4 update is a circulant with nine-point Laurent coefficients a_{0..4}; true entries are their sums by residue j mod n, so examining all residues proves endpoint positivity for arbitrary cycle length. Positive factorizations handle distances zero/two/four; monotone cubics yield thresholds n=3,4,5 and unaliased or wrapped distance-three coefficients yield n=6:1/2, n=7:4/7, n>=8:1/2. Fourier largest Laplacian eigenvalue Λ_n gives spectral cutoff β/Λ_n, equal to positivity only n=3,4. Independently expanded all shift coefficients symbolically for n=3..9, checked mass conservation, critical cubics and distance-three aliases. The analytical residue/monotonicity proof handles all n; finite symbolic instances are checks only.
